articles.summary: AI headlines focus on chips, but the race to scale AI infrastructure is increasingly shaped by what surrounds them. Power, fiber and operational control will define who can deploy faster, operate more efficiently and turn compute capacity into real-world performance.
articles.title: The invisible infrastructure behind the AI boom

articles.summary: Fiber now passes more than 60% of US households. The industry has done the hard part. But coverage and connection are not the same thing, and connection and satisfaction aren’t either. The next phase of fiber will be won or lost on what happens after the build.
articles.title: Mind the gap: Why "homes passed" is no longer enough

articles.summary: OSA Mobile from Openreach addresses the complexity of dense small-cell transport by bringing together open architecture and collaboration to simplify scaling.
articles.title: Adtran, Corning and Openreach shortlisting for SCF Award shows a smarter way to scale small cells
